def_en: 1a4) to enquire of, consult (of deity, oracle)
1b) (Niphal) to ask for oneself, ask leave of absence
1d2) to grant, make over to, let (one) ask (successfully) or give or lend on request (then) grant or make over to
kjv: ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, [idiom] earnestly, enquire, [phrase] greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require, [phrase] salute, [idiom] straitly, [idiom] surely, wish.
expl: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand
